goal: Build an AMR pickup-handoff station: Nova Carter docks at cell, Franka picks cube and places in onboard bin on AMR, AMR departs. Realizes Phase 8 yrkesroll #3 (logistics persona — autonomous mobile robot integration).
thoughts: 2026-05-20 rewrite: replaced create_wheeled_robot (DEPRECATED for Carter, produced placeholder geometry with no ArticulationAPI — AMR missing from scene) with robot_wizard(robot_name='carter') which loads the real Nova Carter USD asset.
Carter z=0.30: ground top at z=0.0 (Ground Cube at z=-0.5, scale z=1 → top at 0.0). Carter origin ~0.30m above wheel contact; was 0.10 causing below-ground spawn.
Sequence: Carter pre-parked at dock [0.6, -0.5, 0.30] → Franka picks cube from belt → places in AmrBin → navigate_to drives Carter to outbound staging [2.5, -1.5].
navigate_to after pick-place ensures visible AMR motion in simulation.
AmrBin at z=0.75 (world coords) is the Franka drop target; bin is NOT a child of Carter to avoid world-coord shift when Carter moves.
Function-gate: cube delivered to /World/AmrBin. Franka planner should not need Carter as a planning obstacle since it is parked to the side of the workspace.
code:
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, 0.375], scale=[1.0, 0.5, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068],
)

create_conveyor(
    prim_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.78],
    size=[1.5, 0.3, 0.05],
    surface_velocity=[0.15, 0, 0],
)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# Nova Carter via robot_wizard — z=0.30: ground top at z=0.0, Carter origin ~0.30m above wheel contact.
# Parked at dock position alongside the drop zone; create_wheeled_robot DEPRECATED for Carter.
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="carter",
    dest_path="/World/Carter",
    position=[0.6, -0.5, 0.30],
    orientation=[1, 0, 0, 0],
)

create_bin(prim_path="/World/AmrBin", position=[0.6, -0.5, 0.75], size=[0.20, 0.20, 0.10])

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.4, 0.4, 0.835], size=[0.06, 0.06, 0.06])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/AmrBin",
    drop_target=[0.6, -0.5, 0.82],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/ConveyorBelt"],
)

# Carter departs to outbound staging area after Franka places cube in bin
navigate_to(
    robot_path="/World/Carter",
    target_position=[2.5, -1.5],
    target_orientation=0.0,
    start_after_s=20.0,
    attach_cargo="/World/AmrBin,/World/Cube_1",
)
extension_notes: Logistics persona: autonomous mobile robot pickup. Carter fixed at dock for V0 (no driving). Future expansion: navigate_to before pickup, navigate_to after placement.
failure_modes: robot_wizard('carter') requires 'carter' alias in robot_wizard registry — alias 'carter' → 'nova_carter' per standard registry.
AmrBin is a world-space prim (not parented to Carter); Franka drop_target is world-fixed so no coord shift, but bin won't move with Carter if navigate_to drives Carter away mid-pick.
navigate_to executes asynchronously — bin should already contain cube before Carter departs; ordering is managed by setup_pick_place_controller completing before navigate_to is called.
Carter as large prim near Franka workspace — ensure Carter is parked to the side (y=-0.5) outside cuRobo planning region.

)
